== Missing data ==

Bill asked (25 October 2026) whether she played or was Decipher staff. Searched with no further mention of her:
* All 253 archived DecipherCon 1999 pages on decipher.com (event scores for SW, ST and YJ events, schedules, Lalumiere day wrap-ups, World Championship finalists, special guests, Who's Playing, and all photo captions). Only photo sun14 names her.
* Archived DecipherCon 2000, 2002 and 2003 pages on decipher.com (about 500 pages: reports, photo pages, video clips).
* SWCCG wiki full text, Decipher deck designs, the Players Committee forum search ("Emery", "Brianna"), and general web search.
No tournament result, decklist, staff credit, card credit, rulebook credit or volunteer role was found. Decipher's sun14 caption gives no role; in the same Sunday set, sun13 calls [[Trevor Hinkley]] a volunteer and sun16 places [[Marcus Sheppard]] on Decipher's Euro Marketing crew.
